hypothesis: The current vendor-published GHCR image plus NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all exposes both RTX 3090 Vulkan devices; the prior Docker Hub runtime failure may have been due to an incomplete invocation/older registry artifact.

sourceEvidence.claim: Current vendor instructions use ghcr.io/agentionai/agention-llama:server; NVIDIA command includes --gpus all and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all.
Official model card specifies vendor llama.cpp build, recommends vendor container for Vulkan, and says Strata support is coming.

passGate: CLI lists both NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 devices.
failGate: Any loader failure, no devices, or fewer than both local RTX 3090s; stop without model download and remove only the pinned image if consumer-free.
continuation: Only after PASS, verify D free space and download the exact Q152 candidate revision/file/hash, then load and run its preregistered dual-3090 BCB-Hard-8 screen.
